plugins.name: log-decisions
plugins.description: Append-only DECISIONS.md journal recording the consequential calls the spec didn't settle — what was chosen, by whom, and why, with decide / assume / escalate rules for what an agent may settle alone.

plugins.name: lessons
plugins.description: Review a repo's merged work since the last review, record each lesson in LESSONS.md with its evidence, and promote lessons seen on 3 separate days into the code standards.

plugins.name: distill-prompt
plugins.description: Distill a conversation's underlying goal into one reusable prompt that reaches the same final outcome in a fresh session.
